value.rationale: The representation refines a natural 2025 torus Rips homotopy classification and a closer translation-only one. Its nontrivial coordinate-swap sign is mathematically necessary to decide whether the unique translation-invariant 4-class descends to the full symmetry quotient. It proves the quotient is rationally acyclic, a structural property not inferred from the Betti number or restricted translation character.
